title: Typhoon Choi-wan's trough to bring scattered rains to Visayas, Mindanao

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Philippines — Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms will affect parts of the Visayas and Mindanao on Sunday, October 4, due to the trough, or extension, of Typhoon Choi-wan outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR). The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said affected areas include Western Visayas, the Negros Island Region, Central Visayas, Southern Leyte, and Mindanao. Moderate to at times heavy rains throughout the day may trigger flash floods and landslides, the bureau warned.
